content: रूप {%a.%} = अनुरूप <ab>q. v.</ab> (शक्तीश्च … करवालांश्च … स्वदेहरूपाण्यादाय गदाश्चोग्रप्रदर्शनाः) <ls>Mb. 1. 30. 49</ls>.

रूपम् [रूप् क भावे अच् वा <ls>Uṇ. 3. 28</ls>] .²1 Form, figure, appearance; विरूपं रूपवन्तं वा पुमानित्येव भुञ्जते <ls>Pt. 1. 143</ls>; so सुरूप, कुरूप <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Form or the quality of colour (one of the 24 guṇas of the Vaiśeṣikas); चक्षुर्मात्रग्राह्मजातिमान् गुणो रूपम् <ls>Tarka K.</ls>; (it is of six kinds:-- शुक्ल, कृष्ण, पीत, रक्त, हरित, कपिल, or of seven, if चित्र be added). .²3 Any visible object or thing. .²4 A handsome form or figure, beautiful form, beauty, elegance, grace; मानुषीषु कथं वा स्यादस्य रूपस्य संभवः <ls>Ś. 1. 25</ls>; विद्या नाम नरस्य रूपमधिकम् <ls>Bh. 2. 20</ls>; रूपं जरा हन्ति <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 Natural state or condition, nature, property, characteristic, essence; circumstances (<ab>opp.</ab> to ‘time’ and ‘place’); देशं रूपं च कालं च व्यवहारविधौ स्थितः <ls>Ms. 8. 45</ls>. .²6 Mode, manner. .²7 A sign, feature. .²8 Kind, sort, species. .²9 An image, a reflected image. .²10 Similitude, resemblance. .²11 Specimen, type, pattern. .²12 An inflected form, the form of a noun or a verb derived from inflection (declension or conjugation). .²13 The number one, an arithmetical unit. .²14 An integer. .²15 A drama, play; see रूपक. .²16 Acquiring familiarity with any book by learning it by heart or by frequent recitation. .²17 Cattle. .²18 A sound, a word. .²19 A known quantity. .²20 A beast. .²21 A verse. .²22 A name. .²23 The white colour. .²24 A particular coin (as a rupee); कस्यचिद् गृहे चोरयित्वा रूपाभिग्राहितो बद्धः <ls>Dk. 2. 4</ls>. .²25 Silver; मसारगल्वर्कसुवर्णरूपैः <ls>Mb. 7. 16. 54</ls>. (रूप is frequently used at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> in the sense of ‘formed or composed of’, ‘consisting of’, ‘in the form of’, ‘namely’; ‘having the appearance or colour of’, तपोरूपं धनम्; धर्मरूपः सखा <ab>&c.</ab>). .{@-पः@} --{%m.%} a deer.
